title: Body Transparency Client Side
features: A simple script (NOT-FE) that makes your body almost invisible, useful uh.. I don't know, you have more range of vision in your area I guess..
script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local function applyTransparency()
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not character then return end


    for _, part in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "Head" then
            part.Transparency = 0.9 -- Body Transparency 
			        elseif part.Name == "Head" then
            part.Transparency = 1 --Head Transparency
        end
    end

    local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
    if head then
        local face = head:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Decal")
        if face then
            face:Destroy()
        end
    end

    for _, item in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
        if item:IsA("Accessory") or item:IsA("Clothing") then
            item.Handle.Transparency = 1
        end
    end
end

LocalPlayer.CharacterAppearanceLoaded:Connect(function()
    applyTransparency()
end)

LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    task.wait(1)
    applyTransparency()
end)

task.wait(1)
applyTransparency()
